messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "seek medical attention for fast, slow, or irregular heartbeat, shortness of breath, or fainting"
set: ["seek medical attention for fast, slow, or irregular heartbeat, shortness of breath, or fainting", "fast, pounding, or irregular heartbeats", "seek emergency medical attention", "seek emergency medical attention for black or bloody stools", "contact doctor or seek emergency medical attention for uncontrolled bleeding", "seek emergency medical attention for coughing up blood", "seek emergency medical attention for blood in urine", "caregiver should seek emergency medical attention", "seek emergency medical attention or call your doctor right away", "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if fall or hit head", "monitor for dizziness or fainting", "wheezing or shortness of breath", "seek emergency medical attention for bleeding that will not stop", "dizziness or fainting", "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if bleeding will not stop", "seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
